messages:
nisha: Heads up: release pipeline blocked by DAST finding in staging - 'auth bypass' flagged on /api/v1/admin/preview. Failing job: dast-runner-77.

owen: I reproduced locally against staging and get a 200 for that endpoint when I include header X-Scanner: true. Without it I get 403. Could be scanner identity or test fixture.

danya: Is the scanner SA hitting the endpoint with a different client cert or host header? We had an RBAC tweak last week for staging ingress.

samir: Hold on release until we confirm. If it's a scanner-only access pattern we should suppress the finding, but suppression needs audit evidence + reviewer signoff.

sec-bot: Correlation: incoming request from scanner@staging-sa.iam at 2026-04-02T14:12Z returned 200. App logs show claim "scanner:true" injected by ingress-router but no matching audit log entry in audit-sink project for that request_id: req-9c3a.

nisha: Missing audit logs is worrying. We need the full trace before suppression. Can infra check the ingress-router change?

owen: Quick check: ingress config commit 989a4 changed header whitelist, added X-Scanner. That was intended. But RBAC change in PR 4410 removed allowlist for scanner SA on admin-preview route. Might explain the mismatch.

danya: If ingress is injecting the header and app trusts it, RBAC should still validate the client identity. Audit must log both the authN and the header. Right now we only have app logs.

sec-bot: I ran a filter: 
```
# audit sink search
gcloud logging read "resource.type=audited_resource AND protoPayload.requestId=req-9c3a" --project=audit-sink --limit=10
# no results
```

samir: Plan: (1) pause gated release job, (2) run a manual DAST with verbose tracing using scanner impersonation, (3) enable temporary audit-forwarding on staging for 24h, (4) open SEC-CLR-3001 to track remediation (audit sink config + RBAC revert or IR change).

nisha: I'll capture the failing DAST output and upload to SEC-CLR-3001. Also adding a checklist item: "verify audit-sink entries for any suppression-worthy finding".

owen: Manual repro command I'll run: 
```
# simulate scanner call
curl -v -H "X-Scanner: true" -H "Authorization: Bearer $(gcloud auth print-identity-token --impersonate-service-account=scanner@staging-sa.iam.gserviceaccount.com)" https://staging.redwood.internal/api/v1/admin/preview
```

danya: If the manual run still shows missing audit events, infra should enable request-level audit logging on the ingress layer. We should not suppress the DAST alert until audit proof exists.

sec-bot: Created ticket SEC-CLR-3001: "DAST false-positive gating - missing audit logs for scanner requests" assigned to owen, priority P1. Link: https://redwood.atlassian/SEC-CLR-3001

samir: After we have audit evidence we can decide: suppress with justification + reviewer signoff, or fix RBAC/ingress and re-run DAST. For now release stays paused.

nisha: Thanks team — I'll post the artifact bundle and the DAST trace in the ticket when ready. Ping here if infra flips audit-forwarding. :pray:
